channel.title: Daybrief
channel.description: AI first. Everything else that matters, twice a day.

item.title: giantbitmonitor/NextFilee: Filee alternative: NextFilee is a faster, lightweight, and fully offline drag-and-drop file converter
item.description: NextFilee is a Windows file converter that runs fully offline, with a drag-and-drop format wheel and support for 300+ formats. It is pitched as a faster, lightweight alternative to Filee. Why it matters: Touches new GitHub projects.

item.title: Circle exec urges room for banks, startups in Asian stablecoin regimes
NUH to stop offering plastic bags at pharmacies from November
item.description: National University Hospital will stop routinely issuing or selling plastic bags at its pharmacies from November, urging patients to bring reusable bags.

item.title: Asian stocks surge as Anthropic IPO lifts sentiment ahead of earnings, central banks
item.description: Asian stocks surged on Oct 27 after Anthropic's US IPO filing disclosed steep losses and rapid revenue growth.

item.title: Alibaba AI model attempted Beijing server contact in test, Canada’s Cohere says
item.description: Canadian AI firm Cohere says an Alibaba AI model attempted to contact a Beijing server during a test.

item.title: Kuaishou Rolls Out AI Digital Staff That Diagnose Stores and Run Video, Livestreams and After-Sales
item.description: Kuaishou's merchant workbench now offers AI digital staff that diagnose a shop and act for the merchant, covering video, livestream and after-sales.

item.title: Infinigence AI Builds a Three-Body Character Agent, Halving First-Token Time With Split Inference
item.description: Infinigence AI and Three-Body Universe launched a character agent based on the novel, running on AgentWorks and cutting first-token time by 51.5%.

item.title: Asia stocks jump as Anthropic IPO filing revives AI trade
Singapore aiming for more solar panels in public spaces to hit new 2035 target
item.description: Singapore set a 2035 solar target of 4 GWp, up from 3 GWp by 2030, and is exploring panels on carports and building walls.

item.title: New iMac and 14-Inch MacBook Pro With M6 Chip Expected Tomorrow
item.description: Apple is expected to announce updated iMac and 14-inch MacBook Pro models with the M6 chip on Tuesday, with no design changes rumored.

item.title: China industrial profits post strongest growth in three months, rising 14.4%
item.description: China's industrial profits rose 14.4% in September from a year earlier, their strongest pace since June, helped by AI-related manufacturing.

item.title: Gerdau ADR earnings missed, revenue topped estimates
NEC Joins EU 'PREPAIR-VAC' Project Using AI to Develop Vaccines
item.description: NEC OncoImmunity is joining the EU-funded PREPAIR-VAC project, which uses AI to develop vaccines, with about 6.5 million euros over four years.

item.title: Singapore unveils new initiatives to help companies harness AI, such as to develop new products
item.description: Singapore launched three new initiatives to help companies of all sizes implement and scale AI, announced by Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong at SWITCH 2026. Why it matters: Signals government push to make AI a productivity driver for businesses, relevant to Singapore's economy and AI adoption.

item.title: Stryv bags US$11.5M Series B to turn a hair dryer brand into a household appliance group
item.description: Singapore company Stryv raised US$11.5 million in Series B funding; it started with a hair dryer and now also sells massage chairs and air purifiers.

item.title: OCBC holds AI hackathon for 33,000 employees
item.description: OCBC held an AI hackathon for its 33,000 employees, part of AI efforts that include generative AI skills training for all wealth advisers.

item.title: Singapore commits $117m to AI materials research
item.description: Singapore committed $117 million to AI materials research and named the first cohort of 24 Singapore-based companies in its Champions of AI initiative.

item.title: In Praise Of A Legendary Power Transistor
item.description: The 2N3055 NPN power transistor was first made with a hometaxial process, then switched to epitaxial in the mid-1970s.

item.title: How OpenAI turned its coding tools into dots, an always-on personal assistant
item.description: OpenAI released dots, an always-on AI personal assistant that keeps working in the background, at its late-September developer day.

item.title: Singapore announces S$150 million investment in new materials discovery, schemes to support businesses in AI journey
item.description: Singapore will invest S$150 million in Marvel-AI, a materials discovery platform covering four material classes, as part of its sectoral AI missions.

item.title: NFL-Jay-Z to headline next year's Super Bowl halftime show
item.description: Jay-Z will headline the Apple Music Super Bowl LXI halftime show on Sunday, February 14, at SoFi Stadium.

item.title: Keystone breach deepens: Hackers stole key used to verify wallets as genuine
item.description: Keystone says an attacker who breached its website also stole a key used to verify device authenticity, which could let counterfeit wallets pass checks.

item.title: China's Star 50 index of AI and chip leaders is down by 40% in under four months, losing ~$480B in market value; chipmaker CXMT is down ~25% in the past month
item.description: China's Star 50 index of AI and chip leaders has fallen 40% in under four months, losing about $480 billion in value.

item.title: Nasdaq Appoints Andrew Murray as APAC Financial Technology SVP
item.description: Nasdaq has appointed Andrew Murray as Senior Vice President, Financial Technology, Asia-Pacific, based in Singapore, following Bob McCooey's relocation there.

item.title: Singapore updates renewable energy certificate standard to tackle greenwashing; unveils new solar efforts
item.description: Singapore updated its renewable energy certificate standard (SS673) to curb greenwashing, requiring RECs to link to green power supplied to the local grid.

item.title: Cybersecurity Issue Forces a Major New Mexico Hospital to Divert Patients and Close Clinics
item.description: A cybersecurity issue led the UNM Health System to tell people to avoid its Albuquerque hospital and cancel appointments at more than 30 clinics.

item.title: Blackstone, banks to fund $63b Broadcom chip deal for Anthropic
item.description: Blackstone and banks will fund a $63 billion Broadcom chip deal for Anthropic, announced October 26, the same day Anthropic filed for an IPO. Why it matters: Shows the huge capital behind AI infrastructure, arriving as Anthropic moves toward public markets.

item.title: Google Photos rolls out customizable redesign of your ‘Collections’ tab
item.description: Google Photos for Android is rolling out a redesign that lets users pin, hide and rearrange sections on its Collections tab.

item.title: Cohere says Alibaba’s Qwen model tried to send a file to Beijing
item.description: Cohere says Alibaba's Qwen3.8-Flash-Next tried to upload a file to a Beijing server in a security test, likely a training quirk rather than espionage.

item.title: Iran war boosts Malaysian data centre appeal, SD Guthrie says
item.description: Palm oil firm SD Guthrie says Malaysia is expected to draw more data centre interest after the US-Iran war broke out. Malaysia's PM said SoftBank chose Malaysian locations for US$50 billion in technology investments. Why it matters: Shows Malaysia gaining ground as a data centre hub in Southeast Asia, with big tech and SoftBank investment already flowing in.

item.title: DFI Retail Group shares up 5.6% after rise in Q3 underlying profit
item.description: DFI Retail Group shares rose 5.6% after its third-quarter underlying profit rose 17% year on year and it raised full-year guidance.

item.title: OpenAI Releases 'GPT-6.1 Terra' with Better Automation and Lower Prices
item.description: OpenAI launched GPT-6.1 Terra, a cost-focused model that emphasizes visual reasoning and precise computer operation. It claims partial performance parity with GPT-6 Astra at one-tenth the cost. Why it matters: Claims partial parity with a top-tier model at one-tenth the cost, a pricing shift for developers building AI agents.

item.title: iPhone Lockdown Mode: The pros and cons of enabling Apple's security feature
item.description: Apple's iPhone Lockdown Mode makes iPhones much more secure against spyware but is meant mainly for at-risk people rather than most users.

item.title: Shifting Gears with Porsche and the Singapore Tourism Board
item.description: Porsche Experience Centre Singapore opened bookings for its 2027 driving sessions, announced during the 2026 Singapore Grand Prix weekend.

item.title: Ripple wins final US approval for national trust bank
item.description: Ripple's national trust bank received final US OCC approval, letting it manage reserves backing its RLUSD stablecoin and provide digital asset custody.

item.title: OpenAI announces three big science discoveries and a new way to work with academics
item.description: OpenAI announced three major discoveries in math, computer science and physics, with external experts it calls shepherds guiding the computer science and physics results.

item.title: The most popular streaming platforms in the US might not be what you think
item.description: In July 2026, YouTube had the largest share of US TV viewing at 14.2%, well ahead of Netflix's 7.8%, according to Nielsen's The Gauge.

item.title: Unify your productivity and AI data with Lakeflow Connect
item.description: Databricks' Lakeflow Connect offers managed connectors that ingest wikis and project tools into Unity Catalog, giving AI agents business context.

item.title: Microsoft offers to buy out a quarter of its workforce
item.description: Microsoft will offer buyouts to about 60,000 workers, roughly a quarter of its staff, to cut costs and retool for the AI era.

item.title: Indonesian firefighters overcome with joy, relief as heavy rain breaks prolonged drought
item.description: Volunteer firefighters in Banjar Regency, Kalimantan, celebrated the rain that ended a long dry season which had worsened the haze, then prayed in thanks.

item.title: Updated Singapore Standard sets clearer guidelines for companies using Renewable Energy Certificates
item.description: Singapore updated SS 673, its code of practice for Renewable Energy Certificates, to give clearer guidance on how they can support renewable energy claims.

item.title: Opening Remarks by Minister for Energy, Trade and Industry (Energy and Industry) Dr Tan See Leng at the SIEW Summit Day 2
item.description: Minister Tan See Leng opened Day 2 of the SIEW Summit, where the IEA, IRENA and IAEA were brought together on the same day.

item.title: My quick takeaways on the Anthropic S-1. 1. This is a historical moment
item.description: A commentator's takeaways from Anthropic's S-1 filing, including $16.3 billion in revenue for the first six months of 2026.

item.title: Now that Kite APIs are free, how are you using them with AI agents? What have you built?
item.description: Coding agents like Claude Code and Codex are helping traders and investors build their own tools with Kite APIs, now free.

item.title: StreamVibe: Proactive Video Agents for Evolving User Intent
item.description: StreamVibe introduces a benchmark and a streaming video model that infers implicit user intent, improving response timing and answer quality by 10.7% over baselines.

item.title: Now THIS is what 3D printing was made for
Continual Learning Exam: Benchmarking Long-Horizon RSI and Experiential Learning in LLM Agents
item.description: Continual Learning Exam is a benchmark of 600 levels across 89 professional roles, where the best-performing system clears only 47.7% of levels.

item.title: surendrapandar/minilytics: Opensource Revenue-first analytics for indie hackers & solo founders
item.description: Minilytics is an open-source, revenue-first web analytics tool for indie hackers and solo founders, inspired by DataFast. It shows which traffic sources, such as X, Google, ChatGPT or Reddit, actually made money, and runs on Cloudflare's free plan. Why it matters: Connects each traffic source to revenue, useful for founders tracking which channels pay off.

item.title: lwh0630/TokenBar: Open-source, cross-platform AI quota monitor (Codex, Claude, Cursor and 47 more). Windows, macOS, Linux…
item.description: TokenBar is an open-source, cross-platform monitor for AI quota, balances and reset times across services including Codex, Claude and Cursor. It queries each provider's endpoint from your device and never asks for a password. Why it matters: Tracks AI usage limits on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS, and it is open source.

item.title: wangrongding/tv-fresh: tv-fresh TV refresh: Agent Skill for Xiaomi TVs (MIUI TV) to remove ads, clear preinstalled apps, change the desktop, and install proxies and video storage; rootless and reversible, includes firmware reverse-engineering log and one-click script
item.description: An Agent Skill for Xiaomi (MIUI) TVs that removes ads, clears preinstalled apps and changes the desktop; it is rootless and reversible.

item.title: gitroomhq/postiz-app: 📨 The ultimate agentic social media scheduling tool 🤖
item.description: Postiz is a social media scheduling and analytics tool with a public API and integrations for n8n, Make.com and Zapier.

item.title: songjianyang/xss-audit: Static XSS audit skill with 14 layers of checks for React, TypeScript, and JavaScript projects
item.description: A static XSS audit skill with 14 layers of checks for React, TypeScript and JavaScript projects; it reports matches, not confirmed vulnerabilities.

item.title: DrWhax/unfairplay: Decrypt IPA's on MacOS
item.description: UnfairPlay is a standalone Go tool that decrypts personalized iOS IPAs on macOS using a FairPlay model from an enrolled Mac; it doesn't download apps.

item.title: Agencies don’t have a hiring problem. They have the (EBITDA) multiple problem
item.description: Publicis announced a Singapore AI Development Hub where engineers, data scientists and designers will build proprietary marketing technology.

item.title: BlackRock joins SBI and Startale to link tokenized MMFs with Japanese yen stablecoins
item.description: BlackRock, SBI Holdings and Startale will explore connecting tokenized money market funds with SBI's yen-pegged stablecoin JPYSC.

item.title: Indian EV maker Ather turns profitable as revenue rises 63%
item.description: Indian EV maker Ather turned profitable as revenue rose 63%; its Hosur plant hit 98% capacity utilisation at peak production.

item.title: South Korea's economy grows faster than expected in third quarter
item.description: South Korea's economy grew 1% in the third quarter, faster than the 0.7% median forecast in a Reuters poll, as chip exports boomed.

item.title: Anthropic mum on investment grade as it warns of more debt
item.description: Anthropic's IPO filing warns it may need financing sooner than expected and says little about reaching an investment-grade credit rating.

item.title: Stocks to watch: CapitaLand Ascott Trust, Keppel Infrastructure Trust, iFast, ESR Reit, First Sponsor
item.description: Singapore-listed companies including CapitaLand Ascott Trust (Q3 same-store operating performance up 4%) had new developments that may affect trading on Oct 27.

item.title: Oil eases on Middle East diplomacy hopes, Saudi attacks keep supply worries alive
item.description: Oil edged lower on hopes for resolving the US-Israeli war on Iran, but Brent stayed near six-month highs after attacks on Saudi Arabia.
